units.source_text: 由于我决意不做任何反抗，虽然是在开馆前，我还是说可以作为特殊导游，就向他索要入场券费和导游费。

en.t: Since I had resolved not to resist in any way, even though it was before opening hours, I said I could serve as a special guide and asked him for the admission fee and the guide fee.

units.source_text: 出乎意外，这个彪形醉汉党乖乖地付给了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, this band of hulking drunkards paid obediently.

units.source_text: 然后他望了望吉普车的车厢，说了六出来吧"之类的话。

en.t: Then he looked into the jeep and said something like, "Come on out."
